app.name: Smart Indian Investment Research & Wealth Dashboard

c.label: Conservative
c.description: Below long-run averages; e.g. a poor decade for equities.

m.label: Moderate
m.description: Roughly long-run Indian averages after a full market cycle.

o.label: Optimistic
o.description: Above-average decade. Do not plan around this.

scenarioNote: Scenario returns are USER-EDITABLE ASSUMPTIONS of the fund's portfolio return BEFORE its expense ratio. They are not forecasts and are not derived from any single fund's past CAGR. The fund's expense ratio is subtracted to get the NAV return.

conservative.label: Conservative
conservative.summary: Capital safety first; ~50% equity, rest in low-volatility debt/arbitrage and gold.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.summary: ~65% equity for growth, with stability and gold sleeves to soften drawdowns.

growth.label: Growth
growth.summary: ~85% equity incl. mid/small caps; expect deep interim falls. Only for 7–10+ year money.

scoring.note: Each component is ranked against funds in the same asset class (equity / debt / gold / hybrid) and scaled 0–100. Missing data scores 50 (neutral) and is flagged. Past performance does not predict future returns.

labels.consistency: Consistency (rolling 3-yr CAGR: median & % of windows beating the risk-free proxy)
labels.scaleHistory: Scale & track record (AUM and years of NAV history)

riskFree.proxyLabel: Parag Parikh Liquid Fund (Direct) trailing 3-yr CAGR
riskFree.note: Sharpe/Sortino use the liquid fund's own trailing return as a risk-free proxy; if unavailable, the fallback assumption is used and flagged.

correctionNote: Window dates approximate Nifty 50 peak/trough dates and are editable here. Fund returns over each window are computed from AMFI NAVs on or before each date.

charges.mfNote: Direct plans bought from the AMC/RTA or a direct platform: no brokerage, no demat/DP charge. Stamp duty and STT come from config/tax-rules.json.
charges.etfNote: Brokerage ₹0 matches discount-broker delivery pricing; set your broker's actual charge. Exchange charge is NSE cash-segment rate (verify with your broker's contract note). DP charge ₹13.50 + 18% GST per scrip per sell day is a typical discount-broker figure. Bid-ask spread is an estimate of the cost of crossing the spread on each trade.
